description:
Cancel / close a single roadmap item (list_roadmap returns its id).

    For a DELIVERED or duplicate item that keeps re-parking: once the work has
    shipped, every expand produces no dev-ready tasks and files a recurring
    `roadmap_item_parked` escalation that has to be acked. Cancelling drops the
    item out of the expand queue AND resolves any open expand-lane escalation for
    it. Business-level replay guard: an already expanded/cancelled item changes no
    state, and the dashboard can restore a cancelled item. Refuses (409) while the
    item is actively being expanded (a retry once that iteration ends succeeds).
    Returns {id, status, changed, next_step}.
name: cancel_roadmap_item
title: Cancel Roadmap Item
